name: dsh-docker
description: Docker and Podman as a structured surface: nine `docker_*` tools (state, ps, images, inspect, logs, pull, run, action, start), the engine's own on switch for Docker Desktop and a podman machine, and a Docker tab in the right bar listing this machine's containers and images with start/stop/remove, pull and run. argv-only, no shell, every removal confirmed; zero npm dependencies, no bundled engine.
